home.title: Take turns hosting. Rate every dinner. Reveal the winner.

steps.createBody: Add your friends and pick who hosts when. Everyone gets a date.
steps.hostBody: On the day, the host shows a QR code. Guests scan, pick their name, and score the evening.
steps.revealBody: Scores stay hidden — even from the organizer — until every dinner is done. Then the leaderboard drops.

new.title: New season
new.playersHelp: Add everyone who will host and rate. At least two.
new.deadlineHelp: Results reveal automatically after this date even if some ratings are missing.

season.shareHint: Share this page's link with everyone playing. Open a dinner on its day to show the QR code.
season.scanToJoin: Anyone can scan this to view the schedule and join.
season.codeNotFoundBody: We couldn't find a season for that code. Double-check with your host.
season.claimHelp: Pick your name once — then you can edit your own dinner and rate without re-entering it.

reveal.lockedBody: Nobody can see ratings yet — not even you.
reveal.unlockedBody: Every dinner is done and the ratings are in.

season.revealReady: All ratings are in — you can reveal the results.

season.revealError: Couldn't reveal results — please try again.
season.deleteConfirm: Delete this season and all its ratings? This cannot be undone.
season.readOnly: Only the organizer can edit this season.
season.ownerOnlyBody: Only the organizer who created this season can view its schedule. Guests: use the link or QR your host shares.
